worldcombat.skill.fling.summary: Hurl the held item at the target: power follows its weight, effects follow its kind, and it stays in the world where it lands.
worldcombat.skill.fling.use.1: Hand a Flame Orb or Poison Barb to the foe
worldcombat.skill.fling.use.2: Give a Berry back to the opponent
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.0: Hurls the held item at the target for %1$s Dark physical damage; the item's fling weight sets the power.
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.1: Throws within %1$s blocks after %2$s s; the item's effect lands on hit (a Berry is eaten by the target, a Flame Orb burns, a Poison Barb poisons, a King's Rock flinches).
worldcombat.skill.fling.description.2: By default the item is left at the landing point and can be picked up after %1$s s; when off it shatters and leaves nothing, for x1.2 power.
worldcombat.skill.fling.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.leave: On: the item drops where it lands and can be picked up or used later, at the item's base power; Off: it shatters on impact for x1.2 power and leaves nothing. Both directions trade power for what stays behind.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.ai.ma: Only throw within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
worldcombat.skill.fling.preference.ai.le: When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to throw; when off it stays put.
